session_summary: The player completed the Treasure Run route, earning 30 total coins (5 from pickups + 25 route completion reward), bringing starting/earned currency up to 146 coins after accounting for initial balance state. They successfully purchased the Trail Cap (45 coins) and Moon Hood (80 coins), leaving 21 coins remaining and failing to afford the elite Waypoint Crown item due to a currency shortfall.

observations.evidence: Completing a full Treasure Run route yielded 30 coins total, yet elite cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown sit behind a price point requiring multiple consecutive route completions or specific marketplace incentives.
observations.recommendation: Adjust mid-tier route base coin rewards or introduce minor milestone bonuses to smooth out the currency curve leading up to elite items.

observations.evidence: The player purchased two items sequentially (Trail Cap for 45 and Moon Hood for 80), ending with 21 coins and receiving a 'Not enough coins' message when attempting the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Provide a wishlist or 'coins needed' delta indicator in the marketplace interface when a player attempts to buy an unaffordable item.

feature_requests.title: Daily Route Bounties for Bonus Currency
feature_requests.player_value: Gives players a structured, predictable way to earn extra coins toward high-cost marketplace cosmetics.
feature_requests.rationale: Helps bridge the gap between mid-tier cosmetics and elite items without breaking overall baseline game balance.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Players can check a daily bounty board for rotating route objectives that award bonus coins upon completion.

keep: Clear feedback on marketplace purchase success and remaining coin balances.
Meaningful spending choices where purchasing multiple cheaper items delays acquisition of elite tier items.
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
